images.caption: The pond holds the morning quietly.
images.subject: An intimate view of a rural Odisha pond at dawn. Two pale lotus buds rise out of dark teal water among a few broad rain-beaded leaves, with a soft reflected palm tree broken into ripples. Mist and muted natural light; no grand spectacle.

images.caption: In the woodland, light finds a leaf.
images.subject: A small branch of broad oval kendu leaves in an Odisha woodland, a single drop of rain at the edge of a leaf. Beyond it, a soft mossy pathway and filtered monsoon daylight. Botanical poetic intimacy, not an identification diagram.

images.caption: A few petals. The afternoon stays.

images.caption: The breeze carries what words leave behind.
images.subject: A small off-white and muted red checked cotton gamucha hanging loosely on a simple timber rail near Odisha's coast. Beyond it a soft quiet pale sea horizon and a hint of dune grass. The wind lifts one corner of the cloth. Unhurried everyday human presence without people, no boats.
